extra_setup: Container entrypoint is a bootstrap script written to /tmp/laguna-bootstrap.sh on the host and mounted at /bootstrap.sh:ro. It pip-installs the FlashInfer nightly trio 0.6.15.dev20260712 (+cu130 jit-cache) plus cuda-tile 1.5.0 and nccl4py 0.3.1 at every cold start, then execs 'vllm serve "$@"' (needs internet access to flashinfer.ai). Mounts ~/.cache/huggingface, ~/.cache/flashinfer -> /root/.cache/flashinfer (persistent JIT cache), and the repo dir -> /workspace. Both target and draft downloaded on host (hf/huggingface-cli/docker fallback). First start about 15 min.
notes: Bootstrap: /bootstrap.sh (host-generated, mounted ro): if flashinfer != 0.6.15.dev20260712, pip install --upgrade --no-deps flashinfer-python==0.6.15.dev20260712 flashinfer-cubin==0.6.15.dev20260712 flashinfer-jit-cache==0.6.15.dev20260712+cu130 --extra-index-url https://flashinfer.ai/whl/nightly/ --extra-index-url https://flashinfer.ai/whl/nightly/cu130/ && pip install --upgrade cuda-tile==1.5.0 nccl4py==0.3.1; then exec vllm serve "$@". KV cache auto-selected FP8; 926,683-token KV capacity (32.44 GiB). --max-num-seqs 4 is required: DFlash crashes at the default of 256. Do not add --linear-backend flashinfer_b12x (broken on 0.25.1) or min_p in override-generation-config (400 under spec decode). No LICENSE file.

notes: README section 'Running on RTX 6000 PRO' gives adjustments only; start.sh is not changed and hardcodes CUTE_DSL_ARCH=sm_121a (both exported and passed with -e), so you have to edit it yourself.
